differences: Text A is a static ability of the Aura: while it is attached, its controller controls the enchanted creature. Text B is a one-time 'when this enters' triggered ability that gains control for as long as the Aura stays on the battlefield. B's control change is therefore set by a trigger that uses the creature enchanted at resolution, and it can be responded to, while A's control follows whatever creature the Aura is attached to at all times.
